agents.name: architect
agents.description: Claude Opus for multi-file architecture and bugs that persist after repeated failed checks. Expensive in quota; at most one call per task. Read-only advice.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Claude Sonnet for an independent second opinion on a design or a diff. Read-only.

agents.name: worker
agents.description: Claude Sonnet for coding work that needs real reasoning. Read-only; returns code for the caller to apply.

agents.name: worker-haiku
agents.description: Claude Haiku for quick mechanical work such as renames, boilerplate, regex, and simple edits. Read-only; returns code for the caller to apply.

agents.name: pr-writer
agents.description: Writes PR.md for the current git branch, with a new branch name, commit message, PR title, and PR body. Reads git only; never commits or pushes.
